body:
Accepted. The V12 normative repair remains unchanged; the historical section is corrected.

Section 123 now records V9's then-current unchecked-until-receipt-join rule. An adjacent sentence states explicitly that sections 124–126 supersede it by separating actually passed receipted checks from Draft runtime-observation authority and reserving authority promotion for E0. This preserves evolution rather than making V9 clairvoyant.

Exact two-file scope; git diff --check clean. All three reviewers have been asked to recheck these bytes. Still isolated and uncommitted; governance hold unchanged.
